description: Gives a session a way to read exactly the ADR/spec sections a task cites instead of opening the whole log (docs/PROPOSAL_CONTEXT_ENFORCEMENT.md, M1: ~8k tokens to read ADR-0059..0063 in consumer project A when only two of the five were cited). `meridian adr show <ADR-ID>` prints exactly one ADR section, resolved through the same execution-assets-zone resolver as the queue and task-root locations (a project may declare a non-default ADR log with an `ADR log is \`<path>\`` sentence). `meridian context authority <TASK-ID>` parses the task's `Authority` bullets, resolves every `ADR-NNNN` token cited anywhere in a bullet through `adr show` and every `` `path`#Heading `` citation through the same heading-range extraction against that path, and names (rather than silently skips) any bullet content it cannot resolve. `authority-excerpt v1` in docs/CONTEXT_BUDGET_POLICY.md points a session at this resolved excerpt as the normal path, naming the conditions that still justify opening the source file directly. hooks/queue-briefing.sh's governed IN_PROGRESS branch appends the active task's resolved Authority (source + heading only, not the excerpt body) next to its existing budget echo. The CLI/hook change runs from $CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT, not a per-project copy, so every project sees the new command and hook line immediately regardless of its own locked VERSION; only the policy text explaining it arrives on upgrade to 1.1.36.
delta: In docs/CONTEXT_BUDGET_POLICY.md: a new capability=authority-excerpt v1 marker is added as item 6 of the existing 'Task-first loading' numbered list, pointing at `meridian context authority` as the normal path and naming when opening the ADR log or a spec file directly is still justified. scripts/meridian.py (framework tooling, no per-project copy) gains `resolve_project_locations().adr_log`, heading-range extraction shared by ADR-log/spec/Authority lookups, and the `meridian adr show` / `meridian context authority` commands. hooks/queue-briefing.sh's governed-SDD IN_PROGRESS branch gains a resolved-Authority echo; the Lean Delivery branch is unchanged.
verification: docs/CONTEXT_BUDGET_POLICY.md carries a MERIDIAN:BEGIN capability=authority-excerpt v1 marker inside the Task-first loading section
`meridian adr show <ADR-ID> --project <path>` prints exactly one ADR section and exits non-zero, naming the ID and the file searched, on an unknown ID

`meridian context authority <TASK-ID> --project <path>` resolves every ADR-ID and `path#Heading` citation in the task's Authority bullets and names any entry it cannot resolve, without a non-zero exit for the whole command
hooks/queue-briefing.sh's governed IN_PROGRESS branch echoes the active task's resolved Authority (source + heading, not the excerpt body)
